in_marathi.name: Ranjeeta
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ranjeeta हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Ranjeeta is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Ranjana', which means 'joyful, radiant'. In Hindu mythology, Ranjita is considered a form of the goddess Saraswati, who is the goddess of knowledge, learning, wisdom, and the arts.
